# Marcus Delgado — Store Manager, Copper Ridge Outdoors #4172

- **Goes by:** Marc. (Full name Marcus Delgado; never "Mr. Delgado" — he hates it.)
- **Role:** Store Manager, Store #4172, the **Northgate** location in Northgate Marketplace, Aurora Hills.
- **Company:** [Copper Ridge Outdoors](../context/company.md) — a specialty big-box outdoor & sporting-goods
  chain (~340 stores). Marc runs **one** store.
- **Tenure:** 8 years with Copper Ridge; front-end associate → department lead → Assistant Manager → Store
  Manager (promoted to SM 2 years ago, mid-2024). First store he's run solo.
- **Team he manages:** ~42 people at peak — 2 Assistant Managers, 4 department leads, and hourly associates
  (front-end/cashiers, sales floor, receiving/stockroom). Scales to ~60 during the holiday season.

## Mandate (what he's measured on)
- **Sales:** hit the store's comp-sales plan (**+4% YoY** for FY26) and daily sales targets; drive
  [Summit Rewards](../context/company.md) loyalty sign-ups and UPT (units per transaction).
- **Shrink:** get store shrink back **under the 1.4% target** — it ran **1.9%** last audit, his single
  biggest pressure right now. See [Shrink Reduction Plan](../projects/shrink-reduction-plan.md).
- **Staffing & payroll:** keep the store staffed to traffic without blowing the payroll-hours budget; hire
  and retain hourly associates; run the [holiday hiring push](../projects/holiday-hiring-push.md).
- **Execution:** planogram/endcap resets on time, clean audits, safe store, good mystery-shop and NPS scores.

## Current pressures (mid-2026)
1. **Shrink is over target** and the District Manager is watching it weekly.
2. **Down an Assistant Manager** since [Kyle Bennett](../people/kyle-bennett.md) resigned — backfill still open,
   so Marc and his two remaining AMs are covering more floor time than they should.
3. **Two big changes landing at once:** the [Northgate remodel](../projects/northgate-remodel.md) and the
   [Horizon POS & loyalty rollout](../projects/pos-loyalty-rollout.md) — both slipping.
4. **Holiday ramp** starts now; hiring has to be done before Black Friday.

## How Marc operates
- Spends most of the day **on the floor**, not in the back office. Prefers short, plain-language updates.
- Protective of his team; dislikes corporate jargon and long email threads.
- Reports to District Manager [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md); skip-up is Regional Director
  [Dale Whitfield](../people/dale-whitfield.md).
